resolvedQuestions: Q1: E1 - What is the root cause of generated-artifact drift (leaf-manifest, hub-router, mode-registry, compiled-route manifests, Hermes copies, trigger index) and the smallest authoring-time fix?
Q2: E2 - What is the root cause of the six-file hub version bump plus changelog collision and the smallest fix that removes the multi-file bump requirement?

Q3: E3 - What is the root cause of advisor routing misroutes (13/17 positives, 2/5 negatives passed; file paths pull routes; documentation prompts hit sk-code; keyword ties) and the smallest authoring-time fix?
Q4: E4 - What is the root cause of advisor_recommend never passing --surface-hint to compiled-route, and what is the smallest fix?
Q5: E5 - What is the root cause of doctor (5e, 5i, 13c, 13d) and router-sync checks catching drift only after the fact, and the smallest fix that moves detection to the author's edit?

keyFindings.title: E1 root cause: stored projections with out-of-loop mint triggers; three prevention states (commit-prevented, check-unwired, post-merge-healed).
keyFindings.text: leaf-manifest is excluded from the pre-commit auto-mint trigger (references/assets not in ROUTE_PATHS); the router intent-signal check has no routine caller and fails today (cli-classifier, 23 missing); the trigger index is healed only by CI after push; the compiled graph and SQLite are operator-gated reindexes.

keyFindings.title: E1 smallest fix: extend the existing pre-commit staged-hub dispatch to the leaf corpus and wire the existing checks into the routing-drift CI job.
keyFindings.text: One trigger edit beats a new file; a generic derived-artifact registry is unearned until a sixth family appears.

keyFindings.title: E2 root cause: hand-allocated version stored six times; the changelog command allocates from one checkout and writes one file; parity is doctor-time with a warn carve-out.
keyFindings.text: SKILL.md is authority; four routing artifacts and README follow; the changelog filename carries the same value; guidance names one field; README drift warns on the four hubs that have it (sk-doc 2.2.0.77 vs 2.3.0.0 live).

keyFindings.title: E2 smallest fix: empty the README warn set after repair, then extend /create:changelog to allocate against the shared ref and write all carriers in one command.
keyFindings.text: A registry/lock abstraction and a standalone bump script both fail at the cheaper move.

keyFindings.title: E3 root cause part one: split vocabularies — description.json has no advisor consumer; only graph-metadata intent_signals (1.0) and derived paths (0.35) score; no counter-signal lane exists.
keyFindings.text: The file-path pull is a bounded keyword lane (key_files/source_docs at 0.35), not an ownership rule; the battery's proposed negative_keywords lane has zero occurrences; ties fall to routerPolicy.tieBreak and generic words.

keyFindings.title: E3 root cause part two: two operator-gated reindexes sit between an author edit and the served scorer; the freshness panel is report-only and the compiled graph is stale today.
keyFindings.text: Compiled skill-graph.json generated 2026-10-02 against a newest source stamp of 2026-10-04; the panel always exits 0 by design and has no CI/hook caller.

keyFindings.title: E3 measured failure: battery 13/17 positives and 2/5 negatives, unchanged across the tie-break change; PASS requires >=14/17 and 0/5.
keyFindings.text: The fix order: values first (intent signals for the expected winners), then wire the existing checks and source description.json in the carry generator; a third linter fails the cheaper move.

keyFindings.title: E4 root cause: the front door accepts --surface-hint and the hub docs demand callers pass it, but advisor_recommend's closed option schema and spawn argv never carry it.
keyFindings.text: Zero occurrences of the flag in the handler and tool descriptor; both needed compat idioms (source capability probe; unknown-option retry) already exist in the caller chain.

keyFindings.title: E4 smallest fix: add surfaceHint to the options schema and thread it into the spawn argv, reusing the existing retry; source the value from the existing stack-detection rules.
keyFindings.text: Proof is an advisor-level argv assertion plus a hinted end-to-end order check; the battery cannot prove it.

keyFindings.title: E5 root cause: the rule families live on a third check plane (per-hub doctor plus skill-local umbrella) with no edit-loop trigger; severity carve-outs keep 13c advise-only.
keyFindings.text: parent-skill-check runs only in doctor and CI; the umbrella has no workflow or hook caller; one hub's checker measures ~2s, cheap enough for a scoped commit-time call.

keyFindings.title: E5 smallest fix: empty the warn lists after repair, then extend the pre-commit staged-hub dispatch with the scoped checker and the umbrella; CI wiring second.
keyFindings.text: The orphan-doc history shows the cost: nine docs and a tenth passed every gate while a leg was held back.

keyFindings.title: Cross-class pattern: a derivable value is stored and its re-mint is triggered off the author's surface; attach existing checks to surfaces the author already touches.
keyFindings.text: Ten verified instances across the five classes; the lexical split (author vocabularies vs consumed vocabularies) compounds it.

keyFindings.title: External-audience map: shipped fixes are generators/validators/messages/bump command; toolchain-only fixes are hook/CI wiring, warn values and the advisor hint.
keyFindings.text: validate_skill_package.py already carries parent-skill-check for hubs; standalone roots lack one leaf-freshness check entry.

keyFindings.title: Live defects at synthesis time (left untouched, research-only phase): intent-signal carry FAILED for cli-classifier (23 missing); compiled skill graph STALE (2026-10-02 vs 2026-10-04); trigger index stale by 5 docs (this packet).
keyFindings.text: All three have named repair commands and proofs recorded in the root-cause sections.

ruledOutDirections: pre-commit hook as a new file; derive-manifest-on-read; fleet-wide re-mint per commit; docs-only fixes
version registry/allocation lock; derive follower versions at read time; standalone bump script; CI-only parity check
hook-driven auto-reindex; third vocabulary linter; battery as E4 proof; default-constant or prompt-inferred surface hint
new aggregated authoring gate; fleet-wide checker per commit; reach prober at commit time; one new external authoring gate
claiming composite convergence; applying fixes during the research phase
